what: Editor's descriptions (build_index.py applies them after the describe pass): where a page needs a correction its own claims do not carry. ChatGPT's review of the draft deposit (adopted 2026-10-18) named the severance page.

pages.description: These claims concern what followed the 19 June 2026 Zenodo termination, in the June 2026 papers' account: #868 counts 871 DOIs stripped of public metadata in DataCite and holds that survival tracked DOI role rather than content; #908 reads this as a move from Findable to Registered state; #875 and #876 hold that the records were propagating as deleted through the OpenAIRE Graph's weekly cycle — their account of 22 June; the July correspondence with OpenAIRE (#1082) and the Observatory's measurements (#1045, #1081) put the question to the Graph's releases and its blacklist operation instead, and how the deletions propagate remains unanswered in the record. Later claims hold that the cost of exclusion rises with each durable deposit (#1547). Unbuilt tests specify the DataCite Severance Observatory and state-history harvests (#1044, #1045), EA-DATAHUB-01 validity measures, a dead-to-live crosswalk (#1076), and referent, variant and collision arms for entity substitution (#1634). The page also holds unrelated claims, from the Resonance Engine to Sappho.
pages.basis: #875 (2026-06-22) states the weekly cycle; #1082 (2026-07-14, the Manghi exchange) asks what the next applicable Graph release will do and records the question unanswered; #1081 measures the blacklist operation.
